task.title: Uploading a Recording
task.shortdesc: Send a local recording from OBS Studio, Capture, or Studio Pro to StreamForge Cloud.

step.cmd: Sign in to your StreamForge account at the Cloud web portal.
Click Upload and choose a video file from your computer.
Wait for the upload progress bar to complete.
step.info: Upload speed depends on your connection, not on StreamForge Cloud.

step.cmd: Once uploaded, the recording begins transcoding automatically.

taskbody.result: The recording appears in your library once transcoding finishes, with a shareable link available immediately.
